name: 110 會考模擬二模（文揚 1～3 冊）英語閱讀
source: 文揚 110 學年九年級國中學習成就評量（1～3 冊），答案與解析取自官方詳解
passages: Look at the street map and answer the questions.（街道地圖見第 19、20 題附圖）

Read the following two passages and answer the questions.
【Passage 1】
Justin, a mailman, enjoys his job very much. Every day, he rides his motorcycle and delivers (遞送) letters to hundreds of houses in town.
When Justin works at his job, he always wears a smile on his face and sometimes has a small talk with people at their door.
Justin knows a lot of people in the town. To him, they are just like family.
“My job brings me to a lot of houses in town. I get to know many people. How lucky I am!” Justin said.
【Passage 2】
Ryan works as a bus driver in a big city. He drives a bus around the city twice a day.
When passengers (乘客) get on his bus, he greets (打招呼) them with “Good morning” or “Good afternoon.” When they get off the bus, he says “Thank you. Have a nice day!” to them.
“I love driving a bus. It gives me a wonderful chance to meet different people. I want them to have a great experience riding on my bus,” Ryan said.

【Group chat: Nancy, Chris, Mark, Susan, Robert (5)】
Nancy: Hey, guys! I’m eating an avocado (酪梨). I like avocados! They’re really 【appetizing】. The taste is just right for me. I eat one every day. How about you?
Chris: (貼圖) I love it!
Chris: Avocados are mouth-watering (令人垂涎的). Eating them makes me happy. They’re one of my favorite fruits, but I don’t eat them every day. I eat them once or twice a week.
Nancy: (思考的貼圖)
Mark: Not me! I ate an avocado once, but I really didn’t like it, so I never eat this fruit again.
Nancy: How come? Give it another try! Avocados are healthy. They’re good for you.
Mark: No, thanks.
Susan: You can say that again, Nancy. Avocados are nutritious (營養的). Like you, I have an avocado every day.
Robert: Well, don’t do that, you two. I like avocados, but I eat them only twice a week. True, avocados are nutritious. However, eating too many may make you fat (肥胖；油脂) because they are rich in fat.
Susan: I see.
Nancy: Um.
Robert: By the way, avocados are too expensive. My wife bought two for NT$150 yesterday.
Chris: (笑臉貼圖) You’re right about it!

There are 20 students in Class 805. Read the notices on the bulletin board (公布欄) in the back of the classroom and answer the questions.
【Notice 1】
To Class 805

You can bring a small pet to class and show it to your classmates.
Show time: 9:00～10:00　Show your pet and tell something interesting about it.

【Notice 2】
My Early Life in a Fish Town　Name: Alice Chou
When I was little, my parents worked in a big city. They were very busy, so I lived with my grandparents in a small fish town.
My grandfather was a fisherman. He worked long hours on the sea. In the early morning, my grandmother and I would wait for my grandfather’s boat to get back to the port (港口). When I saw his boat, I would jump with joy and say happily, “Grandpa’s back!”
When my grandfather did not go to sea, he would take me for a walk, tell me a lot of things about the town, and buy an ice cream for me.
I miss my life in the fish town. I miss my grandparents, too.
【Notice 3】
HOW OFTEN DO STUDENTS IN CLASS 805 DO EXERCISE?（圓餅圖）
every day 5%／once a week 15%／twice a week 20%／three times a week 60%

Jerry is interested in squirrels (松鼠). He read about them and wrote some facts in his notebook.
【March 29, 2021　Squirrels】
* They have large eyes. They can see clearly during the day. However, they have a hard time seeing things at night.
* They have a bushy (濃密的) tail. It is about 19 to 25 centimeters long. Their tail is very useful. For example, it can keep a squirrel warm in winter.
【March 30, 2021　Squirrels】
* They are 【omnivores】. They eat mostly nuts (堅果), fruits and seeds, but they eat meat, too. When they are really hungry, they may eat small birds, insects or even young snakes.
* They are like mice in some ways. They both make loud noise. Like mice, squirrels’ front teeth never stop growing because they both need strong teeth to eat something hard. They both feed their young with mother’s milk.
* They are different from mice in some ways. For example, squirrels have a thick tail, but mice’s tail is thin.
【April 7, 2021　A sign in Green Park】
Green Park — DO NOT FEED THE SQUIRRELS!
● If you feed the squirrels, they may get excited and bite.
● Feeding them with wrong food is bad for their health.

（漫畫十格，原圖見第 32 題附圖）
1. Frank lives in an apartment. Jim and his wife Sherry live next to Frank.
2. Frank loves to play loud music after work.
　Sherry: Oh, no! The young man next door is playing music again! Too loud!
　Jim: That’s enough! I’ll call him right away.
3. Sherry (on the phone): Would you please stop the music? It’s hurting my ears.
　Frank: No way! I love the music! It’s my life! Shut (住口) your mouth!
4. Sherry: What!?
5. Sherry: I’ll call the police!
　Frank: OK. Go ahead.
6. Sherry: I’ve changed my mind. I have a good idea.
　Jim: What’s that?
7. Sherry (singing): Listen! I have a dream…
　Jim: Sherry, don’t do that!
8. Frank: Oh, no! The woman next door is singing!
9. Frank (on the phone): 【Give me a break】! Please stop it!
　Sherry: Sorry! Singing is my favorite thing in the world!
10. Frank: Please don’t do it. I’ll stop the music.
　Sherry: OK. Thank you very much! Good night!

【AAA News　March 17, 2021】
On the morning of March 16, Abu, a patas monkey (紅猴), ran away from Mountain Zoo. It happened at 11:30 am, when the zookeeper (動物園管理員) Henry Davis opened the gate of the monkey pen (圍欄) to clean it. Forba, a six-year-old patas monkey, ran out of the pen. Trying to get Forba back to the pen, Davis didn’t keep an eye on Abu, so Abu was able to get away from the pen. Forba was back, but Abu ran away. Davis reported it to the zoo at 11:35 am, but it was too late. Abu was out of the zoo and ran into the mountains.
Here is a picture of Abu.（照片）Abu: 8 years old／83 cm／10 kg／good at climbing trees
If anyone sees Abu, please call Mountain Zoo.
Mountain Zoo　235 Beach Road, Beach Town　Phone: 6678-8890
【Comments (回應)】
Lucy (10:04 am, March 17, 2021): Come on! Another animal got free from Mountain Zoo this month! What’s wrong with the zoo?
Ronald (10:35 am, March 17, 2021): I saw Abu in the mountains at about 7:15 this morning! When I saw it, it ran and hid behind a tree. I didn’t get close to it. I just walked away.
Jack (11:12 am, March 17, 2021): I worry about Abu. Can it find enough food in the mountains?
Michelle (1:16 pm, March 17, 2021): Where is Abu now? Can it be dangerous? Why did Mountain Zoo make a big mistake like this?

【E-mail 1：About Ben Brown】
From: Allen Clark　To: Julie Anderson
Dear Ms. Anderson,
I’m writing to tell you that I’d like to ＿38＿ Ben Brown, a student in your school. At about 7:30 this morning, I didn’t feel well, so I sat on the pavement (人行道). Ben saw me and ran up to me. Then he helped me up and offered (表示願意) to take me to a hospital. He walked me there and stayed by my side when the doctor ＿39＿ on me. He left for school at about 9 am, and I believed he was already late for the first class. Your school should be proud of a kind student like Ben.
Allen Clark

From: Julie Anderson　To: Allen Clark
Dear Mr. Clark,
Thank you for speaking highly of Ben Brown. I hope you are all well now.

Yours,
Julie Anderson

questions.q: Look at the picture. What is in the corner of the room?
questions.e: 依圖示可得知房間的角落處有隻老鼠，選(D)。(A)書桌；(B)檯燈；(C)籃子。

questions.q: With the help of its long ＿＿＿ and hands, a monkey is able to climb up trees easily or swing quickly from tree to tree.
questions.e: 猴子爬樹，以及在樹間活動，除了善用手臂，最有可能也使用長尾(tail)，選(A)。(B)毛髮；(C)耳朵；(D)牙齒。

questions.q: On his way home, Hank saw an apple tree. He ＿＿＿ it hard to get some apples.
questions.e: 要取得樹上的蘋果最有可能的方式是搖動蘋果樹。shook為shake的過去式，選(C)。(A)把……藏起來(hide的過去式)；(B)挖(dig的過去式)；(D)匆忙(hurry的過去式)。

questions.q:
Mark: I was at Julie’s birthday party last night, but I didn’t see Jim.
Emily: That’s ＿＿＿. He never missed her birthday party.
questions.e: Jim從未錯過Julie的生日派對，但昨天竟然沒有參加，讓Emily覺得奇怪(strange)，選(A)。(B)簡單的；(C)可能的；(D)困難的。

questions.q: Monica ＿＿＿ to move to the city and find a job there. It’s time for her to stand on her own feet.
questions.e: to move...為不定詞。四個選項中只有decided(決定)後面要接不定詞，選(D)。(A)繼續、(B)喜愛、(D)完成，後面都是接動名詞。

questions.q: The supermarket is ＿＿＿ the bank. They are not on the same side of the street.
questions.e: 超級市場和銀行不在街道的同一側，推知最有可能在銀行的對面，選(C)。(A)在……裡面；(B)在……的隔壁；(D)在……的左邊。

questions.q: Jessica took a trip to the beautiful island and stayed there for ＿＿＿ a week, from July 2 to July 7.
questions.e: Jessica從7月2日到7月7日都待在島嶼上，差不多(almost)快一個星期的時間，選(C)。(A)只有；(B)超過；(D)終於。

questions.q: Mr. Wu seldom ＿＿＿ e-mail because he hates computers, and he types very slowly. He loves writing letters better.
questions.e: 由Mr. Wu討厭電腦而且打字很慢，推知和寫信相對比的聯繫方式為使用(use)電子郵件，選(A)。(B)握住；(C)拼字；(D)給予。

questions.q: Fifteen years after Ryan moved to the USA, he ＿＿＿ back to Taiwan last week.
questions.e: last week(上星期)為過去時間，動詞要用過去式，選(A)。

questions.q: There ＿＿＿ still a lot of fish in the river last year. But now I can’t see any in it.
questions.e: 去年河裡仍有很多魚。但現在我根本完全看不到魚。表示「存在有」要用there be。去年是過去時間，要用過去式，魚是可數名詞為複數，選(D)。

questions.q: Tom works at a factory. After work, he sells toys at a night market ＿＿＿ he wants to buy a house for his family.
questions.e: 由文意可推知，空格之後的子句主要是解釋Tom下班後在夜市賣玩具的原因，選(D)。(A)所以；(B)當……時；(C)在……之前。

questions.q: Sam’s feet hurt. Walking to the bus stop every morning ＿＿＿ no fun at all.
questions.e: Walking...morning為主要子句的主詞，視為一件事，後面接單數動詞，選(A)。表示事情好不好玩用...be fun；have fun是指人玩得開心。

questions.q: Paul seldom drinks coffee, but his wife Linda ＿＿＿. She drinks four cups a day.
questions.e: but(但是)連接兩個意思對立的句子。but之前出現...seldom drinks coffee(很少喝咖啡)，推知but之後應該是...usually drinks coffee(常常喝咖啡)，用usually does來代替，因此選(C)。

questions.q: The weather was bad, so Carl’s mother asked him not ＿＿＿ swimming, but he didn’t listen to her.
questions.e: 要求某人不要做什麼事要用ask＋人＋not to V來表達，選(B)。

questions.q: Amanda loves expensive new clothes, so she buys them often. Her clothes surely ＿＿＿ her a lot of money.
questions.e: clothes為物品，價值多少錢用cost，選(C)。(A)付錢，主詞為人；(B)花費(時間)，主詞為事件；(D)花費，主詞為人。

questions.q:
Ellen: The bus runs every twenty minutes. It’ll be here soon.
Bob: Hey, look. Here ＿＿＿.
questions.e: 用Here＋主詞(人稱代名詞)＋動詞的句構，來提醒聽話者某件事物的到來，選(B)。

questions.q:
Sam: ＿＿＿ does your brother go to school?
May: He takes the metro. His school is only five minutes’ walk from the station.
questions.e: May的回應提到搭地鐵(take the metro)，推知Sam在詢問交通方式，用How，選(A)。(B)哪裡；(C)哪一個；(D)多久。

questions.q:
Amy: How will the weather be tomorrow?
Ted: It’ll still be very hot, and ＿＿＿ heavy rain in the afternoon.
questions.e: 由heavy rain推知rain為名詞。表示下雨，用there be rain(rain為名詞)表達。談論的是明天的天氣狀況，用簡單未來式，選(D)。rain若是當動詞，用It is going to rain heavily表達。

questions.q: Mia was driving to the City Hospital. She saw a road sign when she was waiting for the green light. Where did she most likely see it?（上圖為地圖，下圖為路標）
questions.e: 由路標看出White街在左邊，Red街在右邊，更遠處是Blue街，可推知Mia等紅綠燈的地方最有可能在D處。

questions.q: Emma and Lisa were going back to the hotel after they saw a movie. Out of the movie theater, they turned left and walked down Second Road. Then they turned left on Red Street, walked down for two blocks, and turned right on Fourth Road. They walked along Fourth Road for one block and got to the hotel. Where did they NOT pass by on their way back to the hotel?
questions.e: 對照題幹和街道圖，推知Emma和Lisa從電影院走回飯店的路徑依序經過(A)銀行、(D)警察局和(B)咖啡店，但是沒經過(C)超市。

questions.q: What are the two passages mainly about?
questions.e: 兩篇文章都是講述樂在工作，選(B)。(A)只有Ryan在大城市裡工作；(C)不是在談論友善的鎮民；(D)並不是在談職業，而在描述工作態度。

questions.q: According to (根據) the reading, which is true?
o: Justin’s job is to collect letters.
Ryan sometimes works at night, but Justin doesn’t.
Both Justin and Ryan meet a lot of people every day.
Both Justin and Ryan start their work early in the morning.
questions.e: Justin和Ryan分別為郵差和公車司機，他們每天都會遇到很多人，選(C)。(A)Justin的工作是送信，不是收信；(B)文章中提到Ryan會跟乘客說早安或午安，推知他在白天工作，文章中沒有提到Justin的工作時段；(D)沒有提到兩個人開始上班的時間。

questions.q: What does 【appetizing】 mean?
questions.e: Nancy說酪梨合她口味，她每天都要吃一個，推知appetizing(美味可口的)的意思為(C)。(A)有用的；(B)可怕的；(D)昂貴的。

questions.q: How many of Nancy’s friends like avocados?
questions.e: 群組中Nancy的四個朋友只有Mark不喜歡吃酪梨，其他三人都喜歡，選(C)。

questions.q: According to the group talk, which is true?
o: Susan thinks avocados are good for health.
Both Susan and Chris eat avocados every day.
Robert and Nancy think avocados are not cheap.
questions.e: Susan認為酪梨營養，選(B)。(A)Mark有吃過一次酪梨，但是他不喜歡；(C)Chris並沒有每天吃酪梨；(D)是Robert和Chris認為酪梨太貴了，不是Nancy。

questions.q: How many students in Class 805 do exercise more than (超過) once a week?
questions.e: 805班的學生每週運動超過一次的占總人數的85%(5%＋60%＋20%)。該班共有20名學生，故為17人(20人×85%)，選(A)。

questions.q: What do the students in Class 805 NOT do on Pet Day?
questions.e: 805班寵物日活動有分享、發問及寫作，但並沒有包括繪畫，選(A)。(B)講話；(C)聆聽；(D)寫作。

questions.q: According to Alice Chou’s passage (文章), which is true?
o: She does not live in the fish town now.
Her grandfather does not care about her.
Her grandmother also worked on his grandfather’s boat.
questions.e: Alice Chou在文章最後一段提到她想念在漁鎮的日子，推知她已不住在該地，選(B)。(A)只提到她很想念祖父母，沒有提到她的祖父母是否已過世；(C)她的祖父不出海捕魚就會陪她；(D)只有她的祖父在船上工作，她的祖母和她則在陸上等船回到港口。

questions.q: Why are squirrels 【omnivores】?
o: They eat both plants and meat.
questions.e: 松鼠除了吃堅果、水果和種子之外，也會吃肉。推知omnivores(雜食動物)的意思為(D)牠們吃植物和肉兩者。(A)牠們以堅果維生；(B)牠們像老鼠；(C)牠們能爬樹。

questions.q: Which is NOT mentioned (提及) about squirrels in Jerry’s notes?
o: Why they can’t see well at nighttime.
How their tail helps them in cold weather.
Why it might be dangerous to feed a squirrel.
questions.e: Jerry的筆記並沒有提到為什麼松鼠在夜間看不清楚，選(B)。(A)牠們的尾巴多長；(C)牠們的尾巴在冬天如何幫助牠們；(D)為何餵食松鼠可能會有危險。

questions.q: Jerry made a comparison (比較) between mice and squirrels. Which can he NOT put in B?（見文氏圖：A 老鼠、C 松鼠、B 兩者相同處）
questions.e: 松鼠和老鼠都會發出(A)噪音、都有(C)堅固的牙齒，(D)牠們的幼獸都是喝母奶。但是牠們的尾巴不一樣，松鼠的尾巴濃密，然而老鼠的尾巴細，選(B)。

questions.q: What does Frank mean when he says 【Give me a break】?（附圖為原漫畫）
o: He wants to sing with Sherry.
He wants Sherry to stop singing.
questions.e: 從Frank不斷地向Sherry求饒：「Please stop it!」及「Please don’t do it.」，並提出只要她不唱歌，他願意關掉音樂做為交換，推知他說「Give me a break!」(饒了我吧！)的用意是(D)他想要Sherry停止唱歌。(A)他將停止放音樂是整個漫畫的最終結果，但並非Frank說這句話的用意；(B)沒有提到他想謝謝Sherry；(C)沒有提到他想和Sherry一起唱歌。

questions.q: What can we learn from the comics?
o: Sherry calls the police for help.
Frank stops Sherry from calling the police.
questions.e: 在最後一格漫畫，Sherry和Frank達成協議：她不唱歌，Frank則關掉音樂，選(A)。(B)Sherry的點子有奏效；(C)Sherry原本要報警，但是她改變心意；(D)Frank說「OK. Go ahead.」(好。去做吧。)表示他不在意Sherry去報警。

questions.q: What is implied (暗示) in the reading?
o: Frank is not a good neighbor.
Frank listens to music all day long.
Sherry is lucky to have a neighbor like Frank.
questions.e: Frank放的音樂很大聲，Sherry跟他抗議，他置之不理，推知他不是個好鄰居，選(A)。(B)沒有提到他們兩人有唱歌的習慣；(C)圖(2)提到Frank喜愛在下班後聽音樂；(D)Frank不會替別人設想，並不是好鄰居，所以Sherry有Frank這樣的鄰居並不幸運。

questions.q: What is the best title (標題) for the news?
o: Looking for a Missing Patas Monkey.
Abu and Forba, Two Patas Monkeys in Mountain Zoo.
questions.e: 這則新聞報導主要是有關Mountain動物園的紅猴Abu，利用管理員忙著把另一隻紅猴趕回圍欄時逃脫，故最適當的標題為(C)找尋一隻失蹤的紅猴。(A)在圍欄中的紅猴；(B)Mountain動物園的管理員們；(D)Abu和Forba，Mountain動物園的兩隻紅猴。

questions.q: How many of the four people said something bad about the zoo in their comments?
questions.e: Lucy和Michelle兩人針對Abu從Mountain動物園逃脫這件事都有所指責，選(B)。

questions.q: What can we learn from the reading?
o: Abu and Forba are of the same age.
Abu and Forba live in the same pen.
Jack was worried about Mountain Zoo.
Ronald called Mountain Zoo on March 17, 2021.
questions.e: Abu和Forba生活在同一個圍欄裡，選(B)。(A)Abu八歲，Forba六歲；(C)Jack擔憂的是Abu是否能在山區裡找到足夠的食物；(D)Ronald只提到他曾在山區看到Abu。

questions.q: 選出最適合填入第 38 格的答案。
questions.e: Allen Clark寫給Julie Anderson的電子郵件第一段談到該校學生Ben Brown熱心幫助他的故事，推知他寫這封信的主要目的是為了表達對這位學生的感謝，選(D)。(A)得到……的消息；(B)和……一起學習；(C)結識。

questions.q: 選出最適合填入第 39 格的答案。
questions.e: Ben Brown協助Allen Clark就醫，並在一旁陪伴他。醫生為Allen Clark做檢查為過去某個時刻正在做的事情，要使用過去進行式，選(C)。

questions.q: 選出最適合填入第 40 格的答案。
questions.e: Julie Anderson回覆給Allen Clark的電子郵件第二段提到Ben Brown幫助了需要協助的人，而這也是他們教導並要求學生要做的事，推知她肯定Ben Brown的好行為，選(C)。(A)說謊；(B)在學校表現很好；(D)上學又遲到了。

questions.q: 選出最適合填入第 41 格的答案。
questions.e: The day after tomorrow(後天)為未來時間，因此Julie Anderson要分享Ben Brown的善行是未來預定要做的事，選(D)。
